items.why: The Financial Times reported OpenAI's annualized revenue is about $20B lower than previously signaled, and chip suppliers sold off hard on the news. AMD fell alongside Intel, Marvell and Sandisk.

A fresh tanker attack in the Persian Gulf plus hurricane-driven production cuts in the Gulf of Mexico lifted Brent crude about 4% toward its highest close since mid-September, reviving inflation worries.
The FT's report on OpenAI's smaller-than-expected annualized revenue pressured AI-linked chip stocks. Higher oil prices and elevated Treasury yields also weighed on high-growth names.
Stocks slipped for a second day on the oil surge and the AI pullback, lifting the VIX as investors priced in more near-term volatility.

market_note: Crude jumped on the tanker attack; chip stocks slid after the FT's OpenAI revenue report.
summary: Stocks fell for a second day as a Persian Gulf tanker attack pushed oil up about 4% and rekindled inflation worries. Chip stocks led the slide after the Financial Times reported OpenAI's annualized revenue is much lower than previously signaled.
